# VRFBuildSetting

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Build` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Build/VRFBuildSetting.cs#L27)

One block of build configuration carried by a build profile: what it is called, what it
checks before a build starts, and what it does when one does.

Subclass this anywhere in an editor assembly and it appears in the "Add Setting" menu -
the same discovery [`ValidationRule`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-validation/ValidationRule) uses for validator checks. That is the
intended way to grow the build configuration: a new setting is one serializable class,
not an edit to the preprocess step or to the settings asset.

Settings are serialized by reference on [`VRFBuildSettings`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-build/VRFBuildSettings), so add fields
freely; renaming or deleting the class itself is what loses data, and
`[MovedFrom]`covers the rename.

```csharp
[Serializable]
public abstract class VRFBuildSetting
```

## Methods

### Apply(VRFBuildContext) {#apply-vrfbuildcontext}

Applies the setting. Runs inside OnPreprocessBuild, and from "Apply Settings Now" in the
Build window, so it must not assume a build is actually in progress -
[`Report`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-build/VRFBuildContext#report) is null outside one.
